LanguageData.StandPainter_SwatchTip: Change color. The stand previews your choice as you pick; Cancel restores what was there.
LanguageData.StandPainter_DirectInputTip: Type a color and press Enter: hex (EFD8AE or #EFD8AE) or a decimal triplet (237,216,174 — bytes, or 0-1 floats). No alpha. When not editing, this shows the current color's hex, ready to copy to another stand.
LanguageData.StandPainter_DropperTip: Pick up this item's color into the open color picker.
LanguageData.StandPainter_OldColorTip: Pick the old color back up — the color this picker opened with.
